item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: This reminds me of Ecce Perago, in that it's a series of connected vignettes about a central theme, in this case being what the factory is. Just like in that article, each 05 has a unique voice and distinct personality that'e easily detectable with our short time in their world. An arrangement that adds up to be a whole much bigger than its individual components, and a real standout tale.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
At first glance, it looks like just a bunch of different, sometimes goofy stories. Of course, the biggest lie is also a hint at the biggest truth: twelve O5's, from twelve dimensions. The Foundation exists in all of them; in the thirteenth it was instead called the Factory. All the things which escaped to other dimensions were simply security breaches, after The Factory branded them. Because that was just how they did. They also weren't as secretive as the Foundation(s), and anyone walking the street that saw something labeled "The Factory" knew to stay the sweet fuck away from it. Or that it was already too late.

And yes, that's the only mildly altered skeleton of my own 001 proposal I had percolating in my head as a "Some day, when I have some degree of clout on this site, maybe.."

Sage, perpetually dour, monks who can't get over how Serious and Important their duties are? Nothing wrong with that, I guess. But don't you think it's awfully cliche?

Realisticly, if such a word can apply in this context, they would have to be unprofessional at some point. A human being can't be super-cereal all the time without cracking in a bad way. Some yahoo asking for their version of a story that everyone knows is layered with multiple false flags seems like a perfect time for a little playfullness to come out.

Idk, I guess I just have this image in my head of the O5's being more like the council that leads the Green Lantern Corps, instead of "just this group of guys," yknow?…

Well, the Foundation was attacked by these parasites which take over people's bodies. The problem is, the parasites had no way of knowing who they had infected, and they had not prepared any sort of code to let each other know that they were not human.
So now the entire Foundation is aliens, but they keep on functioning like they did when they were humans, trying to maintain the disguise so that they won't be found out by the humans. Of which there are none.
And they are all controlled by Elvis. I don't know…
